content.text:
happy sunday, and happy first day of summer —

mira's 18-month vaccines are coming up in about two weeks, so now's a good moment to ring the pediatric office if you haven't booked that visit yet. at this stage she may also start stringing two words together — little things like "more juice" or "bye dada" — so it's worth keeping an ear out and mentioning anything you notice to her doctor at that same appointment. theo is right in the thick of the hopping-and-jumping phase, so if you see him suddenly obsessed with balancing on one foot, that's exactly where he's supposed to be — nothing to do except maybe cheer him on.

on the village side, there's a drop-in parent-and-tot swim at the community pool this saturday that could be a nice outing for the whole crew — low-key, no sign-up pressure, and the water is probably calling everyone's name this time of year.
